features.name: x001_count_saturation
features.description: Count-like x001 scaled by the training-fold upper bound and clipped to reduce outlier leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded monotone axis for cumulative exposure without raw scale dominance.

features.name: x002_standardized_signal
features.description: x002 centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to a three-standard-deviation band.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places x002 on a margin-friendly scale while retaining direction and magnitude.

features.name: x003_standardized_signal
features.description: x003 centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to limit extreme leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a normalized continuous axis for x003 that is compatible with linear margin geometry.

features.name: x004_standardized_signal
features.description: x004 centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped for robust margin behavior.
features.expected_model_benefit: Turns the wide x004 range into a comparable linear contribution while preserving low-versus-high ordering.

features.name: x005_log_saturation
features.description: Skew-reduced x005 using log1p and the training-fold upper bound; zero remains zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses a heavy-tailed measurement into a smooth bounded score, improving SVM margin stability.

features.name: x006_standardized_signal
features.description: x006 centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to a robust finite interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong normalized continuous axis that can contribute directly to a linear margin.

features.name: x007_log_saturation
features.description: Skew-aware bounded scaling for x007 using log1p and the training-fold upper bound.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures relative increases in a small-range skewed variable without letting rare large values dominate.

features.name: x008_standardized_signal
features.description: x008 centered and scaled with training-fold mean and standard deviation, clipped to reduce endpoint leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth age-like progression axis that a linear model can weight directly.

features.name: high_value_composite_load
features.description: Weighted high-side composite across x002, x006, x008, x001, x007, and x003 using training-fold mean-to-upper-range scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an approximate linear projection of simultaneous high readings that a linear model can use directly.

features.name: x005_to_x002_log_ratio
features.description: Log ratio of x005 magnitude to x002 magnitude with denominator protected at 1.0 and clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures proportional imbalance between x005 and x002 that independent raw-value axes may miss.

features.name: overall_numeric_severity_judgment
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 assigned from the row only: 0.0 for a broadly low or typical numeric profile, 0.5 for mixed or moderate elevations, and 1.0 for a strongly elevated combination of x002, x006, and x008 with supporting elevation in x001 or x007. Do not use peer rows, response fields, or future information.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an expert-style monotone ordering that can align with a linear margin when exact thresholds are uncertain.

features.name: row_measurement_reliability_judgment
features.description: Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 assigned from the row only: 1.0 when x002 through x006 appear measured and mutually coherent, 0.5 for one suspect zero or one discordant measurement, and 0.0 for multiple suspect zeros or extreme internal inconsistency. Do not use peer rows, response fields, or future information.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear margin a continuous reliability axis so anomalous measurement patterns can be down-weighted or treated separately.
